# Ñāṇathavikattheraapadāna (Tha-Ap 486)

**ID:** Tha-Ap 486
**Section:** Therāpadāna (tha-ap)
**Collection:** Sutta
**Title (Pali):** Ñāṇathavikattheraapadāna
**tipitaka.org (CST):** https://tipitaka.org/romn/cscd/s0510m2.mul6.xml

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Ñāṇathavikattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 486) is a biographical verse text preserved in the Therāpadāna of the Pali Khuddaka Nikāya. Secondary scholarship citing this text identifies it with the narrative of the ascetic Sumedha resolving to pursue buddhahood before the Buddha Dīpaṅkara rather than attaining immediate nirvāṇa [Karuna in indian buddhist lit]. In this connection, Maurice Winternitz notes that E. Müller compared the Dīpaṅkara account in this Apadāna with parallel versions, suggesting contact with Kumāralāta's *Kalpanāmaṇḍitikā*, though Winternitz concluded that the Apadāna preserves a simpler, unelaborated narrative that likely served as source material [Winternitz 1933].
